title: Telling stories: the past with omdat

lessons.title: Because it happened
explanation: After **omdat** and **dat**, *all* the verbs go to the end. In the past that means the **ge-** word, then **het**:
**Ek het baie gewerk.** → **…omdat ek baie gewerk het.**
With **was**: **Ek was siek.** → **…omdat ek siek was.**
❌ *omdat ek het gewerk* ✅ **omdat ek gewerk het**

examples.af: Ek was moeg, omdat ek baie gewerk het.
examples.en: I was tired because I had worked a lot.

examples.af: Hy het gehuil, omdat hy hartseer was.
examples.en: He cried because he was sad.

examples.af: Ek het nie gekom nie, omdat ek siek was.
examples.en: I didn't come because I was sick.
